teams.name: Jabir KJ
teams.bio: Jabir KJ is the Founder, responsible for university research, admissions and application guidance.

teams.name: Fawaz BH
teams.bio: Fawaz BH is the Chief Marketing Officer of ILMERA Study Abroad and an independent SEO, AEO and GEO consultant based in Kushal Nagar, Kodagu, Karnataka. He runs his own practice at fawazbhseo.in and has worked in SEO since early 2025. His credentials include Ahrefs Academy and Semrush certifications and an Advanced Diploma in Digital Marketing from Adrex Media School.

teams.name: Zaheer KJ
teams.bio: Zaheer KJ is the Chief Financial Officer of ILMERA Study Abroad and a digital marketer with a certification from Adrex Media School. He manages ILMERA's finance and paperwork, including documentation.
